name: declare_plan
description:
Call this FIRST when your response includes output tools (add_document, add_quiz, add_flashcard, add_challenge). Do NOT call for simple text responses — just respond normally.

Interleave add_message before each output tool so each piece gets its own contextual intro. NEVER end with add_message — the system handles the closing automatically.

Examples:
- Simple answer (NO plan needed): Just respond with normal text
- Document: declare_plan(tools=["add_message", "add_document"])
- Quiz: declare_plan(tools=["add_message", "add_quiz"])
- Two quizzes: declare_plan(tools=["add_message", "add_quiz", "add_message", "add_quiz"])
- Doc + quiz: declare_plan(tools=["add_message", "add_document", "add_message", "add_quiz"])
- With threshold concepts: declare_plan(tools=["get_threshold_concepts", "add_message", "add_document"])

Rules:
- MUST be called before any other tool (only when using output tools)
- Include ALL tools you plan to call, in order
- Memory/search tools are called separately — don't include them
- Each output tool should be preceded by an add_message intro
- NEVER end a plan with add_message — the system handles the final follow-up

tools.description: Ordered list of tool names to execute (e.g., ['add_message', 'add_document'])
